what: The MVP map's ground tiles: a grid of 8 columns of 128 x 64 isometric diamonds (2 x 2 units each, drawn at scale 0.5), dusty gravel and asphalt with its white centre line and zebra crossings, roads along world y and along world x.
made_by: python game/tools/build_ground_tiles.py (no PixelLab call in this step)

sources.PixelLab call: one /create-tiles-pro call of T-103 (job f6cf663e-3d60-472a-b5df-b03c6d79fc71, 15 generations, style image road_tile.png); raw tiles and their records in art-archive/T-103/raw/
sources.used: gravel: tiles [0, 1, 2]; asphalt: tiles [4, 5, 6, 7, 9]; not used: 3 and 8

pixellab_calls.settings: style_images: [game/art/ground/road_tile.png] (128 x 64); tile_type isometric, tile_size 128, tile_view top-down (ignored with a style image); no tile_feature
pixellab_calls.prompt: in the log line of the call (game/art/pixellab-generation-log.jsonl) and in each raw record in art-archive/T-103/raw/
pixellab_calls.result: 10 tiles: 0-3 dusty gravel, 4-9 plain asphalt; one round, nothing regenerated

size: each tile 128 x 64 pixels = 2 x 2 units; neighbours at (+64, +32) along world x and (-64, +32) along world y; exact footprint
road_pieces: T-252: the tiles named piece_<piece>_<column><row> are the 2 x 2 tiles (4 x 4 units, the two-tile-wide roads' size) of the corners, T-junctions, crossroads and dead ends listed in pieces, drawn by script from the approved tile; no PixelLab call
brush_pieces: T-263: the road brush's tiles, after T-252's: brush_line_<piece>_<asphalt>_<column><row> are T-252's pieces on the asphalts a0m, g6, g9, and brush_plain_<dead end>_<asphalt>_<column><row> the dead ends (kerb, no centre line) of the roads without a line on every asphalt; drawn by script, no PixelLab call
